record.name: Armenia
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The Ministry of High-Tech Industry's Virtual Institute of AI is a platform for researchers, start-ups and companies, with no evaluation mandate described.

related_bodies.name: Virtual Institute of AI
related_bodies.role: It links researchers and start-ups to mentoring, funding and cloud support as a Ministry of High-Tech Industry platform. No model-evaluation mandate was described.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English search and the ministry's Virtual Institute page describe computational-resource support, research collaboration and ethical leadership. Neither retrieved primary page establishes an institute, or commitment to one, to evaluate advanced models for severe risks. The additional ministry-branded AI website, ai.gov.am/en, carries the generic page title Ministry of the Republic of Armenia; it is recorded as am-r4-ai-institute-homepage. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.
